title: Patient Cancellation of Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing Accessions
content:
This entry covers the **genetic cancellation handling fee**: the fee posted when a patient cancels their own Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class before testing starts.

## The patient's decision

Cancellation of a genetic accession is the patient's own decision, confirmed by the patient personally when they run the cancellation on the accession the agent has located from their verified records.

## Conditions on booking and on the fee

A cancellation of a genetic accession is booked only after every specimen rejection recorded on the other accessions of the same requisition that is still offered a no-charge recollection is answered by a recollection request on file, so that the cancellation notice sent to the patient and the ordering provider lists every collection still owed on the requisition.

For a genetic accession billed to the patient directly, the handling fee is fixed only after a genetic self-pay quote dated within the estimate validity period of the class stands on the accession.

## Tool: `cancel_genetic_test_order_d90cc330`

**Situation of use and capability.** With this tool a patient cancels one of their own genetic-testing orders while testing has not started. One call does all of the following:

- sets the order to *cancelled*, with the reason *patient request* and today's cancellation date, and clears any hold reason;
- credits in full every test or add-on charge line still standing on the order, with the credit reason *cancelled before testing*;
- posts one cancellation handling fee line at the amount given, when that amount is above 0.00;
- brings the order's list-price total to the charges still standing on it.

On success the order shows as cancelled, and its history shows the credits and any handling fee.

**How it is invoked.** This tool belongs to the patient. The agent unlocks `cancel_genetic_test_order_d90cc330` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it on their own order.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | The reference number of the patient's genetic-testing order to cancel, as the agent reads it to the patient from the order lookup. | Id |
| `handling_fee_amount` | The cancellation handling fee in US dollars that the agent tells the patient. | A number of 0.00 or more with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence stating the order reference number, the new status *cancelled*, the cancellation date (YYYY-MM-DD), how many charge lines were credited (an integer), the handling fee posted in US dollars with 2 decimal places (0.00 when none), and the order's list-price total in US dollars with 2 decimal places. The status *cancelled* in the confirmation means the cancellation was recorded.
